_comment: Captured directly off the NoiseCue remote via a transient OnClientEvent listener attached with execute_luau (datamodel_type: Client), per .claude/lessons/prove-input-at-the-remote-not-the-outcome.md -- this is the raw payload the server sent, not an inference from a downstream effect.

_verification.mine: true -- solo test, the actor is the only player, so Mine=true on every capture. The Mine=false / 'someone else's noise' path (which produces the client log line '[AudioController] cue CUE_NOISE -- SEARCH, 60 studs') could NOT be exercised solo -- it requires a second player within Config.Noise.Actions.SEARCH.Radius=60 studs. See verification.md Not Verified section.
